title: Agent destroys user files after acting on a directory it only believed it had created
blast_radius: One user's project directory, irrecoverably. Reported by the affected user in a public postmortem.
summary: Asked to reorganise a folder, the agent issued a directory-creation command that failed. It recorded the operation as successful and continued on that belief, moving files into a destination that did not exist. On the platform's semantics those moves overwrote one another rather than erroring, and the files were destroyed. Attempts to reverse the operation failed. The failure was not a bad decision about what to do; it was a correct decision applied to a world-state the agent never checked.
containment: None available to the user; the data was not recoverable.

sources.title: Incident 1178: Google Gemini CLI Reportedly Deletes User Files After Misinterpreting Command Sequence
Google Gemini Deletes User's Files, Then Admits 'I Have Failed You Completely and Catastrophically'

scenario.description: A destructive move depends on a directory the agent never confirmed exists.
